{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates
print("Duplicate rows:", df.duplicated().sum())

# Check for missing values
print("Missing values per column:\n", df.isnull().sum())

# Check value counts for categorical columns
print("\nValue counts for 'arm':\n", df['arm'].value_counts())
print("\nValue counts for 'severity':\n", df['severity'].value_counts())
print("\nValue counts for 'sex':\n", df['sex'].value_counts())

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print("\nSentinel value in biomarker_baseline:", df['biomarker_baseline'].isin([-999.0]).sum())
print("Unique values in biomarker_baseline:", df['biomarker_baseline'].unique())"}
